ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels versus 30% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity 'hourglass' region narrowing at the median notch. Flanking high-intensity white fields on the left and right lobes. Two distinct, isolated dark circular spots are visible: one on the upper-mid region of the left lobe and one on the upper-mid region of the right lobe. Dense dark mottling persists along the entire trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; interior angle calculated at approximately 35-40 degrees with a deep bounding-box penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; irregular jagged peaks and valleys occur along the entire continuous boundary, isolated from the water surface through high-contrast edge detection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve on the lateral edges of both lobes, tapering to distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, circular low-intensity pixel groups are visible on the far distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, thin, continuous horizontal line of high-contrast pixels bisects the central dark region and extends into the right white lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a distinct horizontal linear mark/scar crossing the mid-section; significant irregular tissue gaps along the trailing edge inconsistent with natural symmetry.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical pair of isolated dark pigmentation spots located on the interior fields of the high-intensity lobes.
